Whatnot is a live shopping and commerce marketplace company. It is seeking 2027 new graduate software engineers to build and launch scalable features, services, and marketplace systems while making sound product and technical decisions. The role involves owning projects end to end, supporting products through launch, and troubleshooting system issues.
